import _codecs
import codecs
def recover(error):
    print('recover', error.encoding, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    return (b'REPAIR' * 20, -1)
_codecs.register_error('utf8_output_audit', recover)
print(_codecs.utf_8_encode('A\ud800Z', 'utf8_output_audit'))
for errors in ('ignore', 'replace', 'surrogatepass', 'surrogateescape', 'backslashreplace', 'xmlcharrefreplace', 'namereplace'):
    print(errors, _codecs.utf_8_encode('A\udc80Z', errors))
encoder = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-8-sig')()
print(encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode(''), encoder.getstate())
print(encoder.encode('A'), encoder.encode('é', True))
encoder.reset()
print(encoder.encode('B'))
def fail(error):
    raise ValueError('guest failure')
_codecs.register_error('utf8_output_fail', fail)
try:
    _codecs.utf_8_encode('\ud800', 'utf8_output_fail')
except ValueError as error:
    print(type(error).__name__, error.args)
